results.title: China has bought about €290bn of Russian fossil fuels since the EU bans.
results.description:
China has bought about €290bn of Russian fossil fuels since the EU bans.

India about €170bn. Türkiye about €110bn.

The EU itself still bought about €80bn, mostly gas plus pipeline crude.

China and India took 87% of Russia’s crude.

September still brought Moscow €625m a day.

Washington has just waived its new sanctions on buyers too.

The barrels changed customers. 

Moscow still gets paid.

results.title: Rússia gás 2026: produção ~683 bcm.
results.description:
Rússia gás 2026: produção ~683 bcm. Exporta pipeline ~117 bcm (fora CEI ~77) + LNG 35 mi t. 

China: Power of Siberia ~39 bcm (~50% do pipeline fora CEI) + ~9 mi t LNG (~25%). Absorve ~30% do total exportado. Dependência alta e crescente (Gazprom pipeline, Novatek LNG), acima da Arábia no óleo, abaixo de Angola.

results.title: You are day dreaming. It does it matter if Singapore stands with Ukraine if the big players are buying Russian. September 2026 data confirms
results.description:
You are day dreaming. It does it matter if Singapore stands with Ukraine if the big players are buying Russian.
September 2026 data confirms China as the largest buyer of Russian fossil fuels at 55% of top importers' revenues, followed by India and the EU, despite Western sanctions and recent US tariff pressures reducing some volumes.

results.title: The Russian oil saga is double standards galore!
results.description:
The Russian oil saga is double standards galore! Europe continues to buy Russian gas, China buys Russian oil, and America imports Russian critical minerals. Yet India was singled out for harsh criticism.

To their credit, PM @narendramodi and Foreign Minister @DrSJaishankar stood their ground and articulated India’s position firmly to the world. The same resolve is evident in trade negotiations, particularly over agriculture and dairy @PiyushGoyal.
